claim: Zhang et al. find HRES better than the named pure-AI models on their strict unprecedented-record subset across most tested leads
scope: ERA5-derived per-grid/per-month records, 2018/2020, specified model versions and common benchmark variants
falsifier: A direct reanalysis of the same files/model versions that reverses the event-subset ordering

claim: The primary study also reports AI underprediction, lower record occurrence/recall, and worsening negative bias with record intensity
scope: paper-defined record events and metrics; not every extreme definition
falsifier: same-benchmark event-level reanalysis showing no tail bias or reversed recall ordering

claim: The primary result is a universal AI-versus-physics ranking for extreme weather
locator: S2 pp.10-15; S3 abstract/results; S4 public data audit
scope: independent quantile/case-study and coarse public-data comparisons show dependence on estimand, region, lead, truth and model release
falsifier: harmonized multi-model multi-region out-of-distribution benchmark with stable direction

claim: At 64x32 on public WeatherBench2 2020 data, the Zhang-style record rule can be reimplemented and yields a different Pangu/HRES ordering at 24/48 hours
scope: public 64x32 ERA5/HRES/Pangu, 1979-2017 thresholds, 2020 valid times, 2m temperature, land/latitude mask; not a 0.25-degree headline replication
falsifier: script cannot load official data or an independently checked output disagrees after fixing coordinate/lead alignment

claim: FastNet proves physical-guided AI has already replaced NWP for extreme-event early warning
scope: FastNet is a proof-of-principle with selected cases/variables and is not operational
falsifier: an operational, independently evaluated, pre-registered extreme-event comparison

claim: A gridded reanalysis benchmark is equivalent to reliable station/operational warning performance
locator: S1 methods limitations; S6 pp.9-11; S7 benchmark design
scope: reanalysis, initialization and station/observation mismatch remain unresolved
falsifier: station-based operational verification with the same model versions and decision thresholds
